title: 第737章 开辟世界人族圣地第736章 天庭扎根寰宇万界香火神道身的提升
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：西游：开局获得太白金星传承第一卷：默认第737章开辟世界，人族圣地（..la）叶云在密室之中，感受着香火神道身的蜕变。
脸上露出满意之色，那神道身愈发凝实，混元道韵流转，信仰之力如海。
到时候，可以直接让香火神道身坐镇万界商会，倒是省得他真身出动了。
至于三霄，总不可能一直麻烦别人坐镇在那里，她们也有自己的事情要忙。
随后，叶云收回目光，继续爆肝。
反正据他来看，这段时间应该是没什么事情发生。
就算有摩擦，也只是局部的，小打小闹，不需要他出马。
继续爆肝三大法门就完事了。
不过，就在这时，他的传信符箓亮了。
叶云神念一扫，竟是那位伏羲前辈发来的讯息。
内容很简单，说是有事情请他帮忙，希望他来一趟。
叶云也没迟疑，起身离开了密室。
毕竟这位伏羲前辈帮助他不少，还传给他天机大道，这份因果得还。
当即，叶云一步迈出，混元道韵流转，大道法则破开虚空。
瞬息之间便来到伏羲所说的地点。
只见一中年男子立于时光长河之中。
河水滔滔，浪花翻滚，每一朵浪花都映照着一段历史。
他周身缭绕大道神纹，无数符箓若隐若现，玄妙莫测。
仿佛与大道融为一体，与时空共生共存。
正是伏羲。
叶云上前执礼，恭敬道：“伏羲前辈。”
伏羲看到叶云，目光带着惊叹。
“许久未见，你已经走到如此高度，不管是修为，亦或是测算之道，都走在了我的前面。”
以往伏羲还能测算出叶云的一二，但如今，即便对方站在面前，却测算不了分毫。
仿佛不存在似的，超脱于大道之外，凌驾于因果之上。
叶云闻言，轻笑道：“侥幸而已，不值一哂。”
语气平淡，却透着一股无形的逼气。
伏羲嘴角一抽，好强的逼气。
以前怎么没发现，这小子还是个逼王？
他哪里知晓，以前叶云还跟他不是很熟，加上要给老前辈一点瑞思拜，所以就收敛了许多。
如今是一回生二回熟，叶云自然就暴露本性了。
“你小子……”
伏羲摇了摇头，哭笑不得。
“走吧，随我去一个地方。”
“到了那里，你就知晓了。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Journey to the West: Obtaining the Taibaijin Star Inheritance at the Beginning Volume 1: Default Chapter 737 Opening up the world, the Holy Land of the Human Race (..la) Ye Yun was in the secret room, feeling the transformation of the incense god's body.
There was a look of satisfaction on his face, the body of Shinto became more and more solid, the rhyme of Hunyuan Tao flowed, and the power of faith was like the sea.
At that time, Xianghuo Shen Dao body can be directly placed in the Ten Thousand Realms Chamber of Commerce, which saves the need for his real body to be dispatched.
As for Sanxiao, they can't always trouble others to sit there. They also have their own things to be busy with.
Afterwards, Ye Yun withdrew his gaze and continued to explode.
Anyway, according to him, nothing should have happened during this period.
Even if there is friction, it is only local and minor, and there is no need for him to take action.
Continue the three methods of liver explosion and you will be done.
However, at this moment, his messenger talisman lit up.
Ye Yun glanced at it with his mind and saw that it was a message from Senior Fu Xi.
The content is very simple, saying that I have something to ask him for help and I hope he will come.
Ye Yun didn't hesitate, got up and left the secret room.
After all, this senior Fu Xi helped him a lot and taught him the secret path of heaven. This karma must be repaid.
Immediately, Ye Yun took a step forward, Hunyuan Dao rhyme circulated, and the law of the Dao broke through the void.
In an instant, they arrived at the place Fuxi mentioned.
I saw a middle-aged man standing in the long river of time.
The river is surging and the waves are rolling. Each wave reflects a piece of history.
His whole body is surrounded by the divine patterns of the avenue, and countless talismans are looming, mysterious and unpredictable.
It seems to be integrated with the avenue, coexisting with time and space.
It was Fuxi.
Ye Yun stepped forward to hold the ceremony and said respectfully: "Senior Fuxi."
Fuxi saw Ye Yun with wonder in his eyes.
"I haven't seen you for a long time. You have reached such a high level. You are ahead of me in terms of cultivation and calculation."
In the past, Fuxi could calculate Ye Yun's skills, but now, even if the opponent is standing in front of him, he can't calculate anything.
As if it does not exist, beyond the avenue, above cause and effect.
Hearing this, Ye Yun chuckled and said, "It's just a fluke, not worth a cent."
The tone was calm, but there was an invisible force.
The corner of Fuxi's mouth twitched, feeling so strong.
Why haven't you noticed before that this guy is still a bitch?
How did he know that Ye Yun was not very familiar with him before, and he wanted to give the old man a little respect, so he restrained himself a lot.
Now that it was the first time and the second time, Ye Yun naturally revealed his true nature.
"You kid..."
Fuxi shook his head, dumbfounded.
"Let's go somewhere with me."
"You'll know when you get there."
